stem:
A student measured the lengths of two worms.

• Worm S was \(\frac{1}{2}\) foot long.

• Worm T was \(\frac{2}{2}\) foot long.

Which statement is true?

options.label: A
options.text: The length of Worm S is greater than the length of Worm T.

options.label: B
options.text: The length of Worm T is greater than the length of Worm S.

options.label: C
options.text: The length of Worm S is equal to the length of Worm T.

options.label: D
options.text: There is not enough information to compare the lengths of the worms.

difficulty_rationale: The problem requires direct comparison of two fractions with like denominators, a straightforward concept for grade 3.
